how.title: How reliability works
how.body: Your score shows how often you turn up for games you’ve joined over the last {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Checking in counts in your favor. A no-show counts against you, and a late cancel counts as half a no-show. We show a score once you’ve played {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}}.
how.green: Reliable: {percent} or higher, with no active yellow card.
how.yellow: Caution: below the reliable level, or you have an active yellow card.
how.red: Restricted: below {percent}, or joining games is paused.
how.new: New player: not enough games yet for a score.

sanctions.title: Account status

yellow_card.name: Yellow card
yellow_card.effect: This is a warning. It doesn’t limit what you can do.
yellow_card.stillAllowed: You can keep joining, hosting and chatting.

join_ban.name: Joining paused
join_ban.effect: You can’t request to join games.
join_ban.stillAllowed: You can still chat in games you’re in.

chat_mute.name: Chat paused
chat_mute.effect: You can’t send messages in game chats. You can still read them.
chat_mute.stillAllowed: You can still join and play games.

visibility_restriction.name: Reduced visibility
visibility_restriction.effect: Your profile is less visible to other players.
visibility_restriction.stillAllowed: You can still join games and chat.

host_suspension.name: Hosting paused
host_suspension.stillAllowed: You can still join games as a player.

permanent_ban.name: Account closed
permanent_ban.effect: You can’t use Sport Talent with this account.

status.disputed: Dispute filed. Still in force until decided.

sanctions.noEndDate: This decision has no end date. A moderator made it.

statement.title: Why this happened
statement.automated: This was decided automatically based on check-in records. A person will review it if you appeal.
statement.askPerson: You can ask for a person to review any decision.

reason.late_cancel: On {date}, you cancelled {gameTitle} less than {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} before it started. Under our late cancel rule, this earns a yellow card.
reason.no_show: You didn’t check in to {gameTitle} on {date}, and it counts as a no-show. Under our attendance rule, a no-show earns a yellow card.
reason.chat_blocks: {count, plural, one {# of your messages was} other {# of your messages were}} blocked in game chats within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} because they broke our community rules. Under our chat rules, repeated blocked messages earn a yellow card and a short chat pause.
reason.escalation_two_cards: You have {cards, plural, one {# active yellow card} other {# active yellow cards}} from the last {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Under our repeated warnings rule, this pauses your ability to request to join games for a set time.
reason.escalation_three_cards: You have {cards, plural, one {# active yellow card} other {# active yellow cards}} from the last {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Under our repeated warnings rule, this pauses your ability to request to join games for a longer time.
reason.toxicity_reports: {reporters, plural, one {# player} other {# players}} reported your behavior in the last {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, and our checks found the reports credible. Under our respect and safety rule, your profile is shown less to other players for a short time.
reason.fake_venue: Other players reported the venue “{venueName}” that you added, and we couldn’t confirm it’s a real place to play. Under our venue accuracy rule, adding places that don’t exist can lead to a restriction.
reason.low_host_rating: Your last {count, plural, one {# rating} other {# ratings}} as a host averaged {average} out of 5, which is below the level we need for hosting. Under our host quality rule, hosting is paused while we review your account.
reason.moderator_decision: A moderator reviewed your account and made this decision. Their note: {reason}

fix.title: How to get back on track
fix.late_cancel: Next time, cancel more than {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} before a game starts. Your reliability recovers as you show up to games.
fix.no_show: Check in to your next games. If you can’t make one, cancel in the app as early as you can. Your reliability recovers as you show up.
fix.chat_blocks: Reword messages that break the rules, and read the community rules if you’re unsure. Chat opens again when the pause ends.
fix.escalation_two_cards: When the pause ends, show up to your next {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} to get back to green. Yellow cards expire on their own after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
fix.escalation_three_cards: When the pause ends, show up to your next {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} to get back to green. Yellow cards expire on their own after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
fix.toxicity_reports: Keep chats and games friendly. The reduced visibility ends by itself, and you don’t need to do anything.
fix.fake_venue: Only add places where people can really play. If we got this wrong, appeal and tell us how to find the venue.
fix.low_host_rating: Read the feedback on your host ratings. You can host again when the review ends.
fix.moderator_decision: Read the note above. If you disagree, you can appeal.
